name: JD Vance
current_role: 50th Vice President of the United States (since January 20, 2025)
summary: JD Vance, a Marine veteran and Yale Law graduate, became known for his 2016 memoir Hillbilly Elegy, worked for Peter Thiel's Mithril Capital, and won Ohio's Senate seat in 2022 with $15 million in super PAC backing from Thiel. Trump chose him as his 2024 running mate; he took office as vice president in January 2025. Rubio has said he would back Vance for the 2028 nomination, though the Republicans' November 2026 midterm losses raised doubts about his standing.

connections.name: Donald Trump

connections.name: David Sacks
connections.description: Vance introduced Sacks to Donald Trump Jr. in March 2024, and Sacks credited Vance with making his June 2024 Trump fundraiser happen; Vance later appeared at Sacks's All-In AI event in 2025.

connections.name: Elon Musk
connections.description: Vance and Musk had a good relationship and spoke regularly even before Vance became Trump's running mate. During the June 2025 Trump–Musk feud Vance called Musk's attacks a "huge mistake" but hoped he would return to the fold, and with Susie Wiles he helped broker a thaw.
